Title: Riverside charity 5K — volunteer briefing
Time: Sat, Apr 12, 08:00–08:30
Description: Hi all — thanks for signing up for the Riverside Food Bank 5K. This is the volunteer briefing before the race: route maps, water-station assignments, and the new check-in flow. Please come to the blue tent behind the boathouse; we'll hand out vests and radios there.

A few notes from last year. Check-in got bottlenecked because nobody knew which table was which, so this time each station has a colour-coded sign and a laminated one-pager. The assistant drafted that one-pager from our notes and it covers the main cases: walk-ups, late registrants, and people who registered but can't find their confirmation email. If something in it looks off, flag it to me before Friday.

We also need two people on the bag-check table from 08:30 to 10:00. Reply here if you can take it. Coffee and pastries are on the charity, and the forecast looks dry.
